title: Two years packaging the thruster into grounded enclosures

tellings.quote: So, after Drew and I did these experiments in 2016, uh I think we spent about two years trying to package it.

plain: A scientist named Charles Buhler says that after he and a colleague, Andrew Arjima, ran experiments in Florida in 2016 on a thruster that he says pushes without fuel, a form of what he calls antigravity propulsion, they spent about two more years packaging it into grounded, sealed boxes. Buhler tells Michels this as someone who did the work, and the point of the packaging was to show the push did not come from ordinary electrical effects around the device.
